description:
ABOUT OUR BRAND AND PRODUCTS:

Chimera Naturals is a functional mushroom wellness brand on a mission to make nature's most powerful adaptogens accessible to everyone. Our product line is built around six purpose-driven mushroom blends — each one formulated to support a specific health outcome:

• NeuroGuard — Mushroom Fusion Coffee for focus and sustained energy without the crash

• Focus Guard — Lion's Mane Focus Blend for mental clarity and cognitive performance

• Chaga Glow Truffles — Antioxidant & Longevity Blend for immune defense and radiance

• Mushroom Guard — Daily MultiVitamin powered by functional mushrooms

• ZenGuard — Reishi Mushroom Blend for calm, stress relief, and sleep support

• EnergyGuard — Cordyceps Mushroom Blend for stamina and physical performance

We also offer a Subscribe & Save program so customers can build mushrooms into their daily wellness routine — and your commissions keep coming in month after month.


---


WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT:


Every Chimera Naturals product is built around one specific outcome — not a generic wellness blend that promises everything and delivers nothing. Your audience always knows exactly what they're getting and why.


We designed our line for real people — busy professionals, fitness enthusiasts, wellness beginners, and anyone who wants clean functional ingredients that actually fit into daily life. From a morning mushroom coffee to a nightly reishi wind-down, there's a Chimera Naturals product for every routine.


We also make it easy to be an affiliate. We provide FDA-compliant claim language, done-for-you creative assets, and a real-time dashboard — so you can focus on creating content, not compliance paperwork.


---


HOW AFFILIATES CAN EARN:


• 15% commission on every sale you refer — no cap on earnings

• 30-day cookie window — if someone clicks your link and buys within 30 days, you get credit

• Monthly payouts via PayPal or ACH

• Earn on subscription orders — your referrals keep paying you


Approved affiliate welcome offer:

Once approved, you'll receive an exclusive 50% off promo code to try our full product line for yourself. The best promoters are genuine fans — we want you to experience Chimera Naturals before you share it with your audience.


Audience discount:

You'll receive a unique promo code to share with your followers, giving them an incentive to buy and you a higher conversion rate.


---


HOW TO PROMOTE US:


Content that converts best for Chimera Naturals:

• Morning routine or "day in my life" content featuring NeuroGuard Mushroom Coffee or Focus Guard

• Before/after wellness journey posts with ZenGuard (calm & sleep) or EnergyGuard (stamina)

• Educational content — what lion's mane does, why chaga is trending, how cordyceps supports athletes

• Unboxing and honest first impression videos

• "Supplements I actually take" style roundup posts

• Recipe content — adding Mushroom Fusion Coffee to lattes, smoothies, or baked goods


Best platforms for our products:

Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, wellness blogs, and email newsletters


We provide every approved affiliate with:

• 50% off welcome promo code

• Unique tracking link and audience discount code

• Product photography and brand assets

• Suggested captions and hashtags

• FDA-compliant claim language so you always know what you can say

• Real-time affiliate dashboard to track clicks, conversions, and earnings


---


OTHER INFORMATION:


Who is a great fit:

• Wellness, health, and fitness creators

• Biohacking and nootropics communities

• Coffee and morning routine influencers

• Yoga, meditation, and mindfulness accounts

• Nutrition bloggers and healthy recipe creators

• Anyone with an engaged audience that values clean functional supplements


Minimum follower requirement: None. We welcome micro-influencers. Engagement and authenticity matter far more than follower count.


Application process: Apply at chimeranaturals.com/affiliates. We review all applications and notify approved affiliates within 3-5 business days. Your 50% off welcome code is issued immediately upon approval.


Compliance: We provide all affiliates with approved claim language. Claims such as "cures," "treats," or "prevents disease" are not permitted under FTC and FDA guidelines — we make this simple and clear for you from day one.


Questions? Email us at nikesuns@pm.me


We can't wait to grow together. 🍄
